title: Month-End Close Checklist (Usage Billing Controls) — Hosted API + Dedicated
author: Emily Stone
body:
## Purpose
This page defines the required **usage billing controls** to be completed as part of Redwood Inference’s **month-end close** and invoice generation process.

These controls ensure:
- **Completeness & accuracy** of usage meters (tokens, embeddings, rerank units, requests) from source telemetry → billing aggregates → invoice line items.
- **Timely detection** of defects (streaming disconnects, retries, missing dimensions, rounding misalignment) before invoices are issued.
- **Auditability**, with a clear evidence trail for how billed units were measured and reviewed.

This checklist is designed for recurring monthly execution aligned with the hosted API invoice run and Dedicated invoicing/commit burn-down reporting.

---

## Scope
**In-scope**
- Hosted API usage billing for: chat/text generation tokens (input/output/cached), embeddings, rerank units, request counts, streaming partials.
- Dedicated usage attribution (where applicable to invoice line items) and commit burn-down reporting alignment.
- Console vs invoice alignment checks that affect customer-visible totals.
- Anomaly review and reconciliation sign-offs.

**Out-of-scope**
- Pricing strategy changes, discount policy changes.
- Major billing system replatforming.
- Revenue recognition policy redesign.

---

## Roles & responsibilities (RACI)
| Activity | Finance (Billing Controls) | FP&A | Telemetry/Eng | Legal | Sales/CS |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| Run pre-invoice checks + compile evidence | R (Emily Stone) | C (Rishi Malhotra) | C (Logan Wright / Nadia Rahman) | I | I |
| Investigate meter anomalies / pipeline defects | C | I | R | I | I |
| Approve invoice hold / re-run decision | A (Laura Bennett) | C | C | C (if customer impact wording) | I |
| Approve customer credits/refunds due to defects | A | C | C | C | I |
| Update customer-facing comms templates | C | I | C | R (Sofia Mendes) | R (Support/CS) |

Legend: R=Responsible, A=Accountable, C=Consulted, I=Informed

---

## Control calendar (recommended)
- **T-7 to T-5 business days (pre-invoice readiness)**: Data completeness + anomaly checks begin; high-severity issues escalated.
- **T-4 to T-2 (reconciliation window)**: Sampling reconciliation executed; known deltas triaged; fixes/backfills planned if needed.
- **T-1 (invoice run readiness)**: Final sign-offs captured; evidence package assembled.
- **T (invoice run day)**: Run completed; spot-check output; confirm console alignment for priority accounts.

If timing differs by region/customer contract, execute controls using the **invoice_run_id** schedule for that cohort.

---

## Checklist A — Pre-invoice meter health checks (must-pass)
**Owner:** Emily Stone (Billing Controls)  
**Consulted:** Logan Wright / Nadia Rahman (Telemetry)  
**When:** T-7 to T-5

### A1. Data freshness & completeness
Confirm that the following datasets are updated through the expected cutoff (UTC) and contain expected partitions.

**Pass criteria**
- No missing hourly/daily partitions for the invoice window.
- No unexpected null rates in required dimensions.

**Required checks (document results in evidence package)**
- Telemetry ingest lag within SLA (≤ 2 hours for hosted API; ≤ 6 hours for long-running batch backfills).
- Billing aggregate tables refreshed successfully for the invoice window.
- Console usage tables refreshed successfully for the invoice window.

**Required dimensions (hosted API)**
- account_id / org_id
- model (canonical model_id)
- region
- endpoint_type (chat/completions/embeddings/rerank)
- meter_version
- aggregation_window (daily + invoice)

### A2. Meter schema / version sanity
Confirm:
- meter_version is present on billing export(s) and matches the expected release for the period.
- invoice_run_id is present and consistent across downstream exports.

**Pass criteria**
- No mixed meter_version values within a single invoice_run_id unless explicitly approved and documented.

### A3. Rounding & streaming accounting guardrail
Verify the month’s invoice pipeline behavior conforms to **ADR-027** (rounding and streaming).

**Pass criteria**
- No evidence of per-request rounding being applied in the invoice aggregator.
- Streaming partial completions are billed only for tokens actually delivered; tokens after client disconnect are not billed.

### A4. Retry / failure outcome separation
Verify retry and request outcomes are correctly represented so we do not unintentionally double bill or bill failed work contrary to policy.

**Pass criteria**
- Billed meters exclude non-billable outcomes per meter definition (see Hosted API meter definitions v3).
- No spike in retried_request tokens without a corresponding spike in successful completions.

---

## Checklist B — Anomaly review (must-complete)
**Owner:** Allison Grant (Observability) + Emily Stone (Billing Controls)  
**When:** T-6 to T-3

### B1. Spend & usage spike detection
Review anomaly dashboards/alerts for the month and focus on the invoice window:
- Top 20 accounts by usage
- Accounts with >30% week-over-week token change
- Accounts with negative deltas (potential backfill/late arriving data)

**Pass criteria**
- All anomalies are categorized and have an owner + disposition:
  - Expected (customer launch, workload shift)
  - Data pipeline/backfill artifact (suppression documented)
  - Suspected metering defect (investigate)
  - Customer misuse / abuse pattern (route to Support/Sec as appropriate)

### B2. Console vs invoice alignment spot-check
Select a risk-based sample:
- Top 10 accounts by invoice amount
- Any account with an open billing-related support ticket
- Any account flagged by anomaly detection

**Pass criteria**
- Console usage totals and invoice-ready totals align within tolerance (see below) after applying known differences (timezone, model alias mapping, in-flight usage).

**Default tolerance guidance**
- ≤ 0.5% relative delta OR ≤ $250 absolute delta per account, whichever is higher.

If above tolerance: open a ticket and escalate (see Escalation section).

---

## Checklist C — Meter reconciliation sampling (sign-off required)
**Owner:** Emily Stone (Billing Controls)  
**Consulted:** Logan Wright / Mei Lin  
**When:** T-4 to T-2

Execute the reconciliation sampling methodology defined in:
- Meter reconciliation methodology and sampling

### C1. Sampling required
Minimum coverage each month:
- **Hosted API:** at least 30 accounts total, including (a) top 10 by usage, (b) 10 mid-tier, (c) 10 long-tail/self-serve.
- **Workload mix:** at least 20% of sample must include streaming usage; include at least 5 accounts using embeddings and 5 using rerank if volume exists.
- **Regions/models:** include at least 2 regions and 2 model families.

### C2. Reconciliation comparisons
For each sampled account and meter type:
- Compare raw telemetry-derived aggregates to billing-ready aggregates.
- Validate invoice line item mapping dimensions (model, region, endpoint_type, tier) produce consistent totals.

### C3. Acceptance thresholds
**Default acceptance**
- Within tolerance for ≥ 95% of sampled account-meter pairs.

**Escalation triggers**
- Any single account delta above **2%** with no clear explanation.
- Any systematic skew by model, region, or endpoint_type.
- Any evidence of double counting (retries, streaming segments) or missing usage.

### C4. Reconciliation sign-off
Capture written approval from:
- Finance (Billing Controls): Emily Stone
- Telemetry/Eng: Logan Wright or Nadia Rahman

**Sign-off text template**
"For invoice_run_id = ______ covering period ______, we executed the month-end metering controls described on this page. Reconciliation sampling results are within agreed tolerances except for the documented exceptions below, which have approved dispositions. Approved to proceed with invoice generation."  
Exceptions (if any): ______

---

## Checklist D — Invoice run readiness & post-run spot checks
**Owner:** Emily Stone  
**When:** T-1 and T

### D1. Pre-run readiness (T-1)
- Confirm no open P0/P1 metering incidents.
- Confirm any approved backfills are complete and suppression rules (if applicable) are documented.
- Confirm Legal-approved customer-facing language is ready if any known issue may require proactive comms.

### D2. Post-run spot checks (T)
- Validate invoice export includes meter_version, aggregation_window, and invoice_run_id.
- Validate invoice line-item totals for top 10 accounts are within expected bounds (vs previous month and console).
- If Dedicated invoices are generated: validate commit burn-down aligns with attribution rules for the same period.

---

## Evidence package (audit-ready)
**Owner:** Emily Stone  
**Storage:** Finance & Legal Shared Drive → Month-End Close → Usage Billing Controls → YYYY-MM (restricted)

### Required artifacts (attach or link)
1) **Control execution log** (date/time, who executed each section A–D)
2) **Data completeness proof** (screenshots or query outputs showing partition completeness + freshness)
3) **Anomaly review summary** (list of anomalies, dispositions, and owners)
4) **Console vs invoice spot-check table** (accounts checked, deltas, explanations)
5) **Reconciliation sampling results** (account-meter deltas, acceptance stats, exceptions)
6) **Exception register** (if any): what, why, impact estimate, remediation plan, approval(s)
7) **Final sign-off** (Finance + Telemetry/Eng; include invoice_run_id)
8) **Customer-impacting items** (if any): comms draft, Legal approval link, credit/refund approvals

### Evidence checklist (copy/paste)
- [ ] A1 data freshness & completeness
- [ ] A2 meter schema/version sanity
- [ ] A3 rounding/streaming guardrail
- [ ] A4 retry/outcome separation
- [ ] B1 anomaly review complete
- [ ] B2 console vs invoice spot-check complete
- [ ] C1–C3 reconciliation sampling executed
- [ ] C4 sign-offs captured
- [ ] D1 pre-run readiness confirmed
- [ ] D2 post-run spot checks completed

---

## Escalation & invoice hold policy
If any must-pass check fails or any exception exceeds thresholds:

1) **Open a ticket** (Jira/Linear as appropriate) with:
- invoice_run_id
- impacted accounts + estimated $ exposure
- meter types impacted
- time window
- suspected root cause
- links to query outputs/dashboards

2) **Escalate immediately in Slack**
- #finance (tag Emily Stone, Laura Bennett)
- #eng-sre (if pipeline/availability)
- #eng-platform (if billing hooks/control plane)

3) **Invoice hold decision**
Only Finance (Laura Bennett or delegate) can approve:
- Holding invoices for a subset of accounts
- Re-running invoice generation
- Issuing credits/refunds related to metering defects

4) **Customer disputes**
Use the Billing Discrepancy Triage Runbook for intake, reproduction, and customer-facing language.

---

## Known edge cases (reminders)
- **Streaming disconnects:** ensure tokens after disconnect are not billed; partial usage must match delivered output.
- **Retries:** identify double counting risk; ensure retry_reason/request_outcome are applied per definitions.
- **Caching/batching:** may reduce billed compute but should not change billed token counts unless explicitly defined by meter policy.
- **Timezone boundaries:** invoice aggregation is UTC; console may present localized views—confirm normalization.
- **Model alias mapping:** invoices should map to canonical model_id; console may show friendly aliases.

---

## Change log
- 2026-02-20: Updated acceptance thresholds language; added explicit evidence requirements for meter_version + invoice_run_id; clarified console vs invoice tolerance.
- 2026-01-18: Initial publication aligned to metering sanity checks program roll-out.
